name: Ambient EQ
description: Broad tone controls for sustained sound, and a slow ear that turns down whatever rings out above the rest as layers stack.

params.name: Low cut
params.description: Removes everything below this frequency with a steep slope. At its lowest setting it is out of the signal path altogether.

params.name: Low
params.description: A shelf that lifts or cuts the bottom end, from around 120 Hz down. Up adds weight; down thins a boomy layer.

params.name: Body
params.description: A broad bell around 320 Hz, where stacked layers pile up. Down clears mud and boxiness; up adds warmth.

params.name: Presence
params.description: A broad bell around 3 kHz. Up brings a sound forward and adds bite; down pushes it back and softens harshness.

params.name: Air
params.description: A shelf that lifts or cuts the top end, from around 9 kHz up. Up opens the top; down darkens it.

params.name: High cut
params.description: Removes everything above this frequency with a gentle slope. At its highest setting it is out of the signal path altogether.

params.name: Clear
params.description: How hard any narrow band that rings out above its neighbours is turned down once several layers are sounding. Zero turns it off.

params.name: Clear time
params.description: How fast Clear turns a ringing band down. Short catches a build-up at once; long only acts on what stays. It lets go at half the speed.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. The static part is a plain series EQ (Butterworth cuts, RBJ shelves and bells). Clear is in the family of the resonance suppressors (a spectral compressor keyed on each band's level against its neighbours), reduced to 23 slow bands and a feed-forward detector; not a model of any product.
